update: authority reference unique and epoch exact
slash_post_f05: reputation_out == max(0, reputation_in - floor(reputation_in * slash / stake_in))
one action authorization input consumed and one unique action token burned
authority values cannot substitute registry stake
deregister: nonce and authority epoch authenticated before removal
replay: same replay key rejects across concurrent or restarted evaluation
reserve: registry stake is not authority value and cannot satisfy authority binding
inv10: bridge_proof is distinct opaque proof input
payload_hash is distinct bytes32 action digest
all: non-governed assets conserved except declared fee/change
no implicit payout or residual state output

post_f05_slash_interface.authority: RegistryAuthorityV1.slash_enabled == true with exact policy/token/quantity/value/datum/address binding
post_f05_slash_interface.action: one consumed regular RegistryActionV1 input with exact action policy/token/quantity and one unique action token burned on success
post_f05_slash_interface.destination: fixed reserve credential from authority reference
post_f05_slash_interface.replay: same identity/nonce/epoch evidence cannot be consumed twice
post_f05_slash_interface.substitution: authority/action values cannot substitute registry stake

integer_rules.json_integer: type(value) is int and not bool
